## Synopsis

Prints the manifest strazad stored for the named server, by name or id, as the
app.yaml document that apps install takes, so a change starts from what the
server runs. Every environment value, every value and default in the server
block, and each value the secret scan reads as a secret print as [REDACTED].
In every address, a user part prints as [REDACTED], written %5BREDACTED%5D,
a query and a fragment print as an ellipsis after their marker, and a path
part that reads as a generated secret prints as [REDACTED]. apps install
keeps the stored value wherever a mask still stands at its place.
A file in the apps directory takes no mask, so
write each value there yourself. The document is the only output on stdout,
and it passes strazactl spec validate app as it is.

```
strazactl apps export <server> [flags]
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER and the server you logged into)
```
